crossRefs.note: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
crossRefs.keyword: numbered from a month old and upwards

translations.web: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
translations.bsb: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
translations.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
translations.asv: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
